sheets.prompt: Spirit design reference sheet for a science fiction exploration game: one ember wisp, a floating spirit, drawn four times side by side at the same scale on a plain cream background: front view, side view, three-quarter view, and its fireball wind-up with its four stiff ink petals opened outward like a flower around a white-hot coal, the body tilted back. Beneath the side view its solid black silhouette. A small cloaked human traveller with a round jade fluid backpack stands below it for scale; the wisp hovers four metres up. Body plan: four curved petals of hardened black ink closed into a bud around a glowing coal, a thin ring of light round the bud's waist, two small round pale eyes on the front petal, three drips of ink hanging from its base like a tassel; it bobs slowly, no limbs. The manifestation: the dark folded round a stolen ember, a false flower of light. Palette: glossy ink-black petals with deep violet shadows, a thin white-gold ring, orange and yellow coal, pale lilac eyes. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, restrained cream paper grain, whimsical technology, clear readable construction, fully visible bodies, evenly spaced views, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels, scenery, collage.
